company.name: Fivetran
company.shortDescription: Fivetran is a technology company that automates replicating data into a cloud data platforms.
company.description: Fivetran offers automated data integration and delivers ready-to-use connectors that automatically adapt as schemas and APIs change, ensuring consistent, reliable access to data. Fivetran improves the accuracy of data-driven decisions by continuously synchronizing data from source applications to any destination, allowing analysts to work with the freshest possible data. To accelerate analytics, Fivetran enables warehouse transformations and delivers source-specific analytics templates.

productsAndServices.description: A managed data movement platform for replicating, governing, transforming, and delivering data across applications, databases, warehouses, data lakes, and analytics environments.
productsAndServices.name: Fivetran Platform

productsAndServices.description: Pre-built and customizable pipelines that replicate data from SaaS applications, databases, ERPs, files, and streaming sources into data warehouses, data lakes, and other destinations.
productsAndServices.name: Fivetran Connectors and Data Movement

productsAndServices.description: Reverse ETL pipelines that sync modeled data from warehouses, lakes, and databases into CRMs, marketing platforms, support systems, and other business applications.
productsAndServices.name: Fivetran Activations

productsAndServices.description: A managed service for running scheduled SQL transformations in data warehouses or other destinations to convert replicated data into analytics-ready datasets.
productsAndServices.name: Fivetran Transformations

productsAndServices.description: A managed service that delivers replicated data into open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake for standardized lakehouse storage and analytics.
productsAndServices.name: Fivetran Managed Data Lake Service

productsAndServices.description: An embedded data integration capability that lets software companies offer customer-facing data connections and synchronization within their own applications.
productsAndServices.name: Powered by Fivetran
